  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type

        title:
          title: Title

          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException

        status:
          title: Status

          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true

          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string

Implemented the registration-date default on `POST /api/owners`. When no `registrationDate` is supplied it now defaults to the server's current date, and owners return `registrationDate` in ISO `YYYY-MM-DD` format (a supplied date is preserved).

- **Schema files** (h2, hsqldb, postgres, mysql) — added a `registration_date DATE` column to the `owners` table.

The active persistence path is Spring Data JPA, so the entity mapping handles reads/writes; the JDBC row mappers didn't need changes. The `format: date` serialization produces the required ISO `YYYY-MM-DD` output.
